safety_change: Before recursive root publication, release every staged descendant directory cursor and the staging-root cursor. Windows otherwise rejects renaming a directory tree with open descendant handles. The Windows namespace publication handle now requests FILE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY and FILE_DELETE_CHILD in addition to FILE_ADD_FILE.
